releases.name: v0.1.6 — official Mistral API prices as model cost
releases.body:
## What changed

The plugin no longer reports an empty `cost` list for mistral-vibe models. Vibe bills the workspace balance / abo credits (e.g. the 255 EUR contingency) at the **official Mistral API rates**, so the plugin now fills `Model.Cost` with exactly those prices (USD per 1M tokens):

| Model | input | output | cache read |
|---|---|---|---|
| mistral-large-4-0 | 0.70 | 2.10 | 0.07 |
| mistral-medium-latest | 1.50 | 7.50 | 0.15 |
| zai-glm-5-3 | 1.40 | 4.40 | 0.14 |
| zai-glm-5-3-flash | 0.15 | 0.50 | 0.03 |
| zai-glm-5-3-flash-vibe-free | 0 | 0 | 0 |

Unknown future models keep `cost: []` — nothing is invented.

## Verified

On OpenCode 2.3.2: `/api/model` shows the prices for all mistral-vibe models; a live run (mistral-large-4-0#low, 10469 input / 25 output / 578 cache-read) reports `session.cost = 0.00739 USD`, matching the price formula. `tsc --noEmit` clean.

Commit: 75b9b2a
